methodology: Ozone-Studio Self-Deployment on Ubuntu VPS (tarball + systemd + CLI)

steps.detail: tarball (binary + config.example + systemd unit + DEPLOY.md) to /opt/ozone-studio
enable ozone-studio.service (Restart=always); the service IS the API + orchestrator
ozone-studio doctor runs real checks (config parse, data-dir write probe, pipeline census, port) — run after ANY change
binds 127.0.0.1: secure by default; expose only via tunnel or proxy+firewall
UI files resolve from assets/ first — a frozen bootstrap copy must never shadow source (live-found bug)
